_about: Embraer 195-E2, from APM 5824 Rev 25 (Nov 29/24; Section 02 Aug 05/22) Figure 2.2 General Aircraft Dimensions (page index 20): side, plan and front views on one sheet, black lines over a pale yellow fill (layers.py --mode strokes-in-fill). The side and plan are drawn to one scale (the printed 41.60 m length and 32.87 m nose-to-wing-tip figures agree to 0.1%); the front view is drawn 1.171 times larger (its 35.12 m span's extension lines), so it is rendered at scale 13.667 to the side's. Scaled by the printed 41.60 m length. The E190-E2's (e290/) points moved by the two fuselage plugs (plug.py: 2.88 m ahead of the wing, from the inlet's move; 2.31 m behind it, from the aft door's), then snapped to this sheet; the wing placed here. Pixels of those rasters, line centres. Windows joined to other lines (one to the 6.82 m dimension's extension line, four to the wing's) are placed at their drawn centres (windowsAlso).

sources.title: Embraer, E-Jets E2 Airport Planning Manual (APM 5824 Rev 25, Nov 29/24), Section 02, Figure 2.2 General Aircraft Dimensions (E195-E2); Figure 2.20 cabin cross-section
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off the side, plan and front views (tools/trace/e295/); the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. The front view is drawn at 1.17 times the side's scale and is brought to it from its printed span.
